name: acq_offer_cost_native@value
requires: an epoch whose snapshot has the offer-cost tunables (acquisition.OFFER_COST / OFFER_LEAK / OFFER_REPEAT; run_queue.py --bump-code --areas trades); until then the queue shows the row BLOCKED
notes: Offer cost behaviour gate (docs/PRIORITY_PLAN.md 'Backlog': the trade-offer spam; design in the catanbot/acquisition.py docstring 'offer cost'), the acq_calib_native@value pattern: 40 seeds vs value with --trades native (Catanatron's bots never accept). Candidate: base price 2e-5 win probability per proposal, x4 (OFFER_REPEAT 3.0) per offer of ours in a row that nobody took, reset by an acceptance; a proposal is valued min(E, V_no + P x (V_acc - V_rej)) - price. PASS = under 10 offers a game for the candidate (mech offers_made), 0 adapter errors; report s per game. Hand runs: this row's own block (seeds 420000-420039, run after the parameters were picked on seeds 0-39): 9.2 offers a game vs default 59.7, 0 adapter errors, 3.15 vs 3.51 s per game; seeds 0-39: 9.6 vs 59.6 (the default arm reproduced the queue's acq_calib_native@value default games 40/40); other points on those seeds: price 0.003 alone 27.0, + CALIB_RATE 1 19.9, + REJECT_STREAK 3 5.6 (absorbing, see acq_offer_cost_vrule@value), 0.001 x1.5 13.2, 0.0002 x2 12.2, 5e-5 x3 10.2. Tier smoke: behaviour only, outside every Holm family. Suggest adding acquisition.OFFER_COST / OFFER_LEAK / OFFER_REPEAT to run_queue.py PLAYER_TRADE_NAMES (trade D prior, the trades-on lint).

name: acq_offer_cost_vrule@value
requires: an epoch whose snapshot has the offer-cost tunables (run_queue.py --bump-code --areas trades); until then the queue shows the row BLOCKED
notes: Offer cost no-harm check vs value-rule responders (they accept about 26% of our offers; trading is worth +24.1 pp here, t1_trades0_vrule@value), fixed N = 400 pairs (se ~2.5 pp). Same candidate as acq_offer_cost_native@value; run it only if that gate passed (stop by hand otherwise: the queue cannot read an offers-a-game gate). FAIL (harm) = the upper 95% bound of the win-rate delta below 0; report trades_done and offers_made per game for both arms. Expect harm: in 40-pair smokes on seeds 0-39 every price that stops the spam cost about a third of the executed trades (default 9.5 a game; this candidate 6.2, delta -15.0 +- 6.7 pp; 0.003 alone 5.2 trades, -10.0 +- 7.8; 0.001 x1.5 5.4, -10.0 +- 6.0; the structure alone at price 1e-9, 8.5 trades, -2.5 +- 5.6). Telling a never-accepting table from one that takes 26% of offers needs about 7-10 rejected offers in a row (0.74^k), which is the pass line itself. With REJECT_STREAK 3 the price is absorbing (P = 0 seats are never offered to again, so they never accept to lift it): 3.1-3.3 trades a game, -12.5 to -17.5 pp; do not stack them.

name: acq_offer_cost_selfplay
requires: an epoch whose snapshot has the offer-cost tunables (run_queue.py --bump-code --areas trades); until then the queue shows the row BLOCKED
notes: Offer cost self-play screen, fixed N (1,200 games, 4 players, the acq_calib screen's size): where players do trade. OFFER_REPEAT 3.0 sits in base_spec on both arms because a self-play row takes one tunable: with OFFER_COST = OFFER_LEAK = 0 it is inert (tested: pinned default digest, no run kept), so the default arm is the default bot. Readout: win-rate delta (a no-harm reading: the price's benefit is at human tables, which no bot harness reacts to), plus scripts/acq_mechanism.py's counters. 8-game smoke (acq_mechanism.py, seeds 7700-7707): our proposals 25.3 vs 49.0 a seat-game, accept rate of our offers 24.0% vs 21.4%, executed 5.2 vs 7.4, premium-rule fails 2.0% vs 2.3% of proposals, 1.03x ms per decision. If harm shows here and in acq_offer_cost_vrule@value, route to the deferred-to-human list (the price models a human table's information leak and annoyance) rather than adopting.
